name: One visitor floods the room with emotes
environment: this machine: the park under wrangler dev on port 8797, the stand-in store on port 8791
hypothesis: A visitor sending 50 emotes a second is throttled (its extra emotes dropped, then its socket closed), and nobody else in the room lags or loses a move (OP-089).
blast_radius: One extra scripted visitor in the throwaway park's hub, flooding for 10 s at most.
abort_rule: Any steady-state check failing for more than 30 s during the experiment ends it and runs the rollback; the harness never leaves a fault injected.

observations.what: the flood's emotes the others saw played
observations.fix: play at most one emote per owl every 1.5 s (Room.ts emote) and drop the rest before they are sent on

observations.what: the flooding socket closed by the room
observations.value: after 836 ms and 41 emotes: code 4003 (too many frames)
observations.fix: close a socket that sends past the frame limit (Room.ts admitFrame) for emotes too

observations.what: the others' move echo p95 from the flood's start
observations.fix: drop a flooder's frames before any work is done for them

observations.what: moves the others lost from the flood's start
